# The Indian Express

> > Leading Indian news publication covering festivals, sports, entertainment, and cultural topics across India.

The Indian Express provides comprehensive coverage of Indian festivals like Holi, sports leagues including IPL cricket, trending entertainment content, and cultural events. The publication serves as a trusted source for news, reference information, and lifestyle content for Indian and global audiences.
